descriptions.HEALTHY: no fault, the complaint point behaves normally
descriptions.COV_INC_COARSE: COV increment left at the default 1 on a temperature that moves by tenths
descriptions.COV_SUB_LOST_SAVE: COV subscriptions cancelled by saving the gateway's COV settings
descriptions.COV_LIFETIME_EXPIRED: COV subscription lifetime expired, the client does not renew
descriptions.NOT_EXPORTED: export flag missing (never set, or removed by a project change)
descriptions.TYPE_NOT_EXPORTABLE: group object of a datapoint type that is not exported (date, text)
descriptions.OVER_LIMIT: more exportable objects than the small variant's limit; this one dropped
descriptions.GA_CHANGED: group address changed, so the BACnet instance number changed
descriptions.CMD_MASKS_KNX: BMS command held at a priority above the controller's KNX slot; later KNX changes are masked
descriptions.CMD_NO_EFFECT: BMS command written at a priority below the controller's KNX slot; it never becomes the value
descriptions.CMD_SAME_SLOT: BMS command written into the controller's own KNX slot and relinquished; the value falls back to the frozen Relinquish_Default
descriptions.DUP_DEVICE: a second BACnet device with the same device instance on the network
descriptions.POLL_TOO_SLOW: client polling interval too long for the signal
